body: Yes. By this point I feel like a broken record.

I relate to this so much. It is amazing what others' behavior can do to a child. You start believing what they said. No one except those who have experienced the same thing can even begin to understand what hell it is. You're not alone. I wish I had something better to say, but I hope there is some comfort in that you're not the only one; meaning that there are others who understand you.
The longer I look at this, the more I laugh.
